sources.title: Apple Human Interface Guidelines: App icons
claims: iOS/iPadOS/macOS 1024 square source; system mask; center primary content; full-bleed opaque imported background while foreground transparency is supported; layered and flattened artwork routes; current appearance variants.
sources.retrieval: HTML was JavaScript shell; official DocC JSON fetched with curl and parsed; JSON URL also browsed

sources.title: Apple Icon Composer overview
claims: Multilayer design for Apple platforms; artwork layer effects; flattened export for marketing/communication is distinct from multilayer document.

sources.title: Xcode: Creating your app icon using Icon Composer
claims: SVG/PNG artwork layers; 1024 canvas for iPhone/iPad/Mac, 1088 for Watch; no baked canvas mask; add Composer file to Xcode; simulated/physical-device checks; replacement of catalog and older-release fallback behavior.
sources.retrieval: Official indexed content browsed; direct HTML JS shell and Markdown tool error; official DocC JSON fetched with bounded curl and parsed

sources.title: Xcode: Configuring your app icon using an asset catalog
claims: iOS/iPadOS single 1024 square image size-variant route; dark transparent background and grayscale tinted image guidance; asset-catalog configuration remains distinct from image creation.
sources.retrieval: Official indexed content browsed; direct HTML JS shell and Markdown tool error; official DocC JSON fetched with bounded curl and parsed

sources.title: App Store Connect: Add an app icon
claims: Add icon through Composer or catalog in Xcode, then upload build; changing a published icon requires new app version and review.

sources.title: Android Developers: Adaptive icons
claims: Foreground/background layers; optional intentional monochrome artwork for theming; 108dp layer canvas; central 66dp safe region; 48-66dp icon content; outer 18dp for masking/effects; adaptive XML and manifest resources; Android 16 QPR 2 automatic theming note.

sources.title: Android Developers: Google Play icon design specifications
claims: Listing icon is distinct from APK launcher icon; 512 square, 32-bit PNG, sRGB, max 1024KB; full square without baked outer mask/drop shadow; internal shading allowed; nontransparent background recommended.

googlePlay.nontransparentBackground: recommended, not a categorical prohibition of transparency on this page

cornerConflict.finding: IP lower-corner occupancy can place identity features outside preferred center or safe masks.
cornerConflict.proposal: Keep original draw intact; make any requested platform adaptation a separately labeled derivative with mask checks.

styleRecommendations.construction: Personified soft silhouette, two character colors plus background, lower-corner emergence, minimal depth.
Centered filled non-character circles/blocks/arcs; no depth.
Heavy solid outer shape with one meaningful internal cutout.
Thick continuous rounded stroke with open interior; no filled masses.
A few overlapping flat paper forms with restrained internal depth.
One smoothly volumetric object with broad light/shade; static raster, not native layers.
